repo_notes.content: Stelow is a skills-only, host-agnostic agentic product workflow: ~28 portable agentskills-compatible skills plus one zero-dependency shell helper (scripts/stelow). There is no extension host code, no compiled plugin, and no per-host adapter in this repo — any agent that can read ~/.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md runs the same workflow. Hosts only add an optional marker protocol (STELOW_WORKFLOW=1 + STELOW_STATE=<path>). See architecture.md for the full layout.
repo_notes.author: calionauta

repo_notes.content: The 17-stage pipeline (Setup → Shape → Critique → Gate → Scope → Interface → Planning → Execution → Verification → Audit) is a state machine, not prose: skills/stelow-workflow-orchestrator/stages.yaml is the single source of truth for stages, skills/stelow-workflow-orchestrator/references/transitions.md is the enforced transition table, and skills/stelow-workflow-orchestrator/references/state-contract.md defines state.md. scripts/stelow (bash + python3: status, advance, doctor, seed, schema, ask) is the single source of runtime mechanics. skills/stelow-workflow-entry classifies intent and scaffolds state.md; skills/stelow-workflow-router validates candidates against transitions.md. install.sh flattens skills/* into ~/.agents/skills/. docs/design and docs/agents-md-refs are historical artifacts, not the current contract — prefer architecture.md, SKILL.md files, stages.yaml, and transitions.md.
repo_notes.author: calionauta
